challenge.details.body: Olu hlolo lufutshane lunceda ukugcina iwebhusayithi ifumaneka kuye wonke umntu. Isikhangeli sakho senza umsebenzi omncinci wokubala ukuze siqinisekise olu tyelelo.
challenge.details.randomx: Uhlolo olufuna amandla e-CPU okanye imemori eyongezelelekileyo, njenge-RandomX, lucela imvume yakho ngaphambi kokuba luqale. Ungalishiya eli phepha ukuba awufuni ukuqhubeka.
challenge.hashwx_unsupported: Esi sikhangeli asikwazi ukusebenzisa i-HashWX. Kufuneka sixhase i-WebAssembly ne-Web Workers.
challenge.javascript_required: Nceda uvule i-JavaScript kwisikhangeli sakho, uze uhlaziye eli phepha.
challenge.load_error: Uhlolo aluzange luqale. Uqhagamshelwano lunokuba luyacotha okanye enye ifayile ibhlokiwe.
challenge.randomx_unsupported: Esi sikhangeli asikwazi ukusebenzisa i-RandomX. Kufuneka isikhangeli esixhasa i-WebAssembly, i-BigInt ne-Web Workers.
challenge.state.blocked.description: Isandiso sesikhangeli okanye isihluzi senethiwekhi kusenokwenzeka ukuba sibhlokile ifayile efunwa luhlolo. Vumela le webhusayithi kwisandiso, uze uzame kwakhona.
challenge.state.blocked.title: Into ethile iluvalile uhlolo
challenge.state.connecting.title: Siyaqhagamshela
challenge.state.consent.description: Olu hlolo lusebenzisa amandla amaninzi e-CPU nememori yesixhobo sakho. Luza kuqala kuphela xa ukhetha ukuqhubeka.
challenge.state.consent.title: Kusele inyathelo elinye
challenge.state.cookies.description: Le webhusayithi isebenzisa ikuki ukukhumbula ukuba isikhangeli sakho siluphumelele uvavanyo. Vumela iikuki kule sayithi, uze uzame kwakhona.
challenge.state.cookies.title: Iikuki zivaliwe
challenge.state.expired.description: Olu hlolo luthathe ixesha elide kunelo besililindele. Ukuqala uhlolo olutsha kunganceda.
challenge.state.expired.title: Masizame kwakhona
challenge.state.failed.description: Asikwazanga ukugqiba uhlolo ngeli xesha. Kungaphumelela xa uzama kwakhona.
challenge.state.failed.title: Nceda uzame kwakhona
challenge.state.fast.description: Isikhangeli sakho senza uhlolo olukhawulezayo. Oku kudla ngokugqitywa ngokuzenzekelayo.

challenge.state.hashwx.description: Isikhangeli sakho senza uhlolo olukhawulezayo. Enkosi ngomonde wakho.
